subject: ClearFund - cost anchors & batching levers (post-call recap)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Grant <lisa@clearfund.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 15:23:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap and cost anchors (ClearFund)

Hi Lisa — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our 45-minute discovery so we have alignment and clear next steps. I kept this tight so your procurement/finance team can skim.

Top pain points you called out
- Live model latency spikes during peak batch runs (impacting user flows where confirmations are time-sensitive)
- Unpredictable token spend on open-ended generation (heavy prompt + history usage)
- No current prefix/KV caching; repeat requests for similar customer contexts amplify cost

Goals we heard
- Cap monthly inference spend to $30k during pilot (hard constraint from finance)
- Serve 750–1,000 QPS bursts with p95 latency under 400ms for forwarding confirmations
- Prove 40–60% unit-cost reduction via batching/caching within 60 days to justify expansion

Cost levers we discussed (initial framing)
- Batching: route low-latency tolerant requests to 64–128 token batch windows during off-peak; estimate 20–35% token CPU amortization
- KV/prefix caching: cache the top 15 customer prompts/flows — expected 10–25% token reduction depending on hit-rate
- Model variants: switch ephemeral sessions to an 8-bit quantized variant for background inference to save ~30% on GPU cost per token

Immediate asks / open assumptions
1) You confirmed the $30k pilot cap — if procurement needs a different spend cadence (monthly vs quarterly) flag here.
2) We assumed 20M tokens/month baseline for pilot sizing; let me know if your analytics show a different number.
3) We recommended a 4-week rollout: 1) infra baseline sizing, 2) batching + cache config, 3) ROI measurement.

Attachments: clearfund-inference-snapshot.pdf (outline sizing & sample request distribution)

Next steps (proposed)
- Schedule 30-min ROI workshop (Rishi + Vivek + Marissa) — link: https://calendly.com/marissa/redwood-clearfund-roi
- Rishi to follow up with a rough cost-estimate CSV and technical notes by EOD tomorrow
- Procurement to share any SLA or PO templates if needed — procurement@clearfund.ai

If that all looks right, I'll send a one-page pilot summary + MOA draft for quick internal review.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
[Attachment: clearfund-inference-snapshot.pdf (8 KB)]

From: Lisa Grant <lisa@clearfund.ai>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, procurement@clearfund.ai
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 17:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap and cost anchors (ClearFund)

Marissa — appreciate the crisp recap. This maps well to what we discussed. A couple clarifications / constraints from my side:

- The $30k cap is for a 30-day pilot window; we prefer not to exceed it under any circumstances. If Redwood needs a different commitment model to secure capacity, please call that out.
- Our current estimate is closer to 28M tokens/month right now (mostly short prompts but with a 20% tail of long customer messages).
- Caching hit rate will vary by product line; we expect 8–12% hit-rate initially across our payments confirmation flows, perhaps 20% on the smaller subset of templated messages.

Procurement asked me to loop them in early — they prefer an MOA with a one-month trial and an option to convert to a committed capacity SKU. I've cc'd procurement@clearfund.ai.

Happy to join the ROI workshop. Suggest adding a short line item that shows "cost per confirmed conversation" so we can map to the finance KPI for CAC recovery.

Thanks,
Lisa
Head of Product, ClearFund
lisa@clearfund.ai

Thanks for the recap — adding a quick technical cost sketch and a couple of concrete knobs we can flip in week 1.

On Wed, Jun 18, 2025 at 17:02, Lisa Grant <lisa@clearfund.ai> wrote:
> Marissa — appreciate the crisp recap. This maps well to what we discussed. A couple clarifications / constraints from my side:
>
> - The $30k cap is for a 30-day pilot window; we prefer not to exceed it under any circumstances. If Redwood needs a different commitment model to secure capacity, please call that out.

Technical sketch (very rough) — numbers are illustrative; I'll convert to a CSV and attach: rough-estimates.csv
- Baseline: 28M tokens/mo -> est $26k/mo on the hosted catalog model variants (no batching)
- Batching only (light): 20% cost reduction -> ~$20.8k/mo
- Batching + KV caching (initial 12% hit): additional 12% reduction -> ~$18.3k/mo
- Quantized background variant for non-sensitive flows: additional ~25% infra saving on those calls -> blended pilot spend target ~ $14.5–$17.5k (depends on traffic split)

Technical next steps
1) Share the rough-estimates.csv (attached) with your finance team so they can sanity-check line items.
2) We recommend an early canary window where we enable batching only during 2–8pm PST for 7 days to measure latency regressions.
3) For the cache, we'll propose a 15-key prefix cache per customer session initially; we'll instrument hit-rate metrics to evaluate ROI.

Procurement notes: we can support a one-month MOA and convert to Dedicated Reserved pools if you want guaranteed throughput after the pilot. Marissa — I can draft the MOA language for the pilot scope and opt-in conversion clause.

Cheers,
Rishi Malhotra
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.ai

Operational asks
- Lisa / procurement: can you confirm the PO cadence (monthly vs quarterly) and whether we should include a one-time onboarding fee? If yes, procurement, please send the template and I'll slot it into the MOA.
- Lisa: please confirm if the 28M token number includes test traffic or if we should provision a 10% buffer.

Proposed schedule
- Week 0 (next Tue): 30-min ROI workshop — walk the CSV line items, agree hit-rate assumptions, and finalize MOA wording. Please pick a slot: https://calendly.com/marissa/redwood-clearfund-roi
- Week 1: Canary batching window + telemetry collection (2–8pm PST)
- Week 3–4: Cache roll-out + quantized background routing, measure unit-cost at day 30

I'm attaching a 1-page MOA draft to speed review if procurement wants to move quick. If you confirm the PO cadence I can update the payment terms.

Attachments: clearfund-moa-draft.docx (12 KB)

Next action: procurement to confirm cadence; Rishi to send a one-page technical appendix we can attach to the MOA. If I don't hear back by EOD Tuesday I will schedule the ROI workshop for Wednesday 10am PST and share an invite.

Thanks all — excited to get started.
